pokedexEntries.ru: BEAUTIFLY’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this POKéMON, just leave a potted flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY is sure to come looking for pollen.

pokedexEntries.sa: BEAUTIFLY has a long mouth like a coiled needle, which is very convenient for collecting pollen from flowers. This POKéMON rides the spring winds as it flits around gathering pollen.

pokedexEntries.frlg: Despite its appearance, it has an aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing with its long, thin mouth.

pokedexEntries.em: Its colorfully patterned wings are its most prominent feature. It flies through flower-covered fields collecting pollen. It attacks ferociously when angered.

pokedexEntries.di: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.

pokedexEntries.prl: When flower fields bloom, it flits around, collecting pollen. Despite its appearance, it is savage.

pokedexEntries.pt: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.

pokedexEntries.hgss: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.

pokedexEntries.la: A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.
